items.title: The scalar endpoint step in Bakry–Émery interpolation

source.attribution: Mathlib supplies the one-sided scalar comparison; Samplinglib packages the endpoint orientation used by Bakry–Émery semigroup interpolation.

items.statement: A continuous scalar interpolation satisfying the exact right-derivative lower bound Φ'≥rΦ obeys Φ(s)≤Φ(t)e^{-r(t-s)} for every s≤t.
assumptions: The interpolation is real-valued and continuous.
Its exact right derivative is supplied at every time.
The lower differential inequality holds at every time.
The endpoints are ordered; no sign condition on the rate or interpolation is needed.

obligations.label: Convert the interpolation derivative lower bound into the exact endpoint contraction factor

bindings.boundary: Concrete semigroup order preservation, the derivative identity for P_s Γ(P_{t-s}f), the Γ₂ curvature inequality, and generator-domain closure remain separate analytic prerequisites.

assumption_deltas.source: Mathlib gives an upper right-slope Grönwall comparison for a continuous scalar function on an interval.
assumption_deltas.lean: Samplinglib assumes a globally continuous interpolation with an exact right derivative and a global lower differential bound, then applies Mathlib to its negation between arbitrary ordered endpoints.
assumption_deltas.reason: Negation changes the lower growth inequality into Mathlib's upper comparison. Global hypotheses match the reusable API, while the proof consumes them only on [s,t].
